BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Ybarra, Dent, Orcutt, Klippert, and Van Werven
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Making the custom farming and hauling farm products tax exemptions permanent.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making the custom farming and hauling farm products tax exemptions permanent; repealing 2014 c 140 s 40 and 2007 c 334 s 4 (uncodified); and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:
The provisions of RCW 82.32.805 and 82.32.808 do not apply to this act.
